meta.name: Hotel Transylvania 3 Summer Vacation
meta.description: Dracula, Mavis, Johnny and the rest of the Drac Pack take a vacation on a luxury Monster Cruise Ship, where Dracula falls in love with the ship’s captain, Ericka, who’s secretly a descendant of Abraham Van Helsing, the notorious monster slayer.
meta.slogan: He's going to need a vacation after this vacation.
